[h1]BUY THIS INSTEAD OF THE ORIGINAL[/h1]

If you're torn between this and the original don't be. The original copies of Luxor notoriously have issues playing on modern operating systems, the HD versions don't suffer from these issues and are essentially the exact same game, minus some obvious visual/display improvements

As for gameplay, it's the original Luxor, if you've played Zuma then you'll know the gameplay, match 3 and watch the trail of balls get pushed back if there's a gap between two matching colors. Get some power ups, have fun.

Main thing for me is the sound design of the balls launching, exploding and rolling back, burned into my mind from childhood and given new life in this HD rerelease.

非常优秀的一部作品，对比原作Luxor(2005) 有了相当大的改动，动态的地图背景焕然一新。一些地图进行了微调，主要目的是平衡难度或者适配16：9界面。有些改动则是趋近于二代的风格，比如局内intro、stage complete音效、sphere样式、achievement中统计的数据、游戏可选择的模式等。甚至有些是三代的元素，比如survival和practice的选关界面、stage complete的边框样式、how to play的背景以及mian menu背景等。需要提及的是本作虽然已经在Luxor HD(2011) 的基础上进行了游戏内容上的优化但依然存在少量bug：1.某一难度下通关13-10后选择进入下一难度，接着不打1-1直接到main menu，然后重进adventure会丢失之前的lives、score这些数据。2.不同机型（我不确定是机型原因还是windows版本原因）游玩时灵敏度可能有不同（有些情况下发射器相对于鼠标有延迟），虽然正常情况下的手感仍然不如Luxor 2 和 Luxor 3 。3.Achievement中spheres destoryed一栏Turquoise和Orange数量统计是反的，powerups collected中的这两个颜色也是反的。4.局内发射器偶现点击后未响应的问题，左键右键都有过（在后期关卡中一个球点一下发射不出去然后要再点一下还是很烦的，抑或是fireball想存在手里秒切右键发射结果fireball发射出去了）。5.局内多次右键偶现吞道具的问题，触发条件未知（貌似是在一直存道具直到一列消灭下一列出现才有可能触发这个bug）。以上是目前回想到的bug。总体来说本作创新性还是很高的，而且特效精美丰富、可玩性很强，还原性略有欠缺，不过还是值得推荐。

Definitely one of my favorite casual games. Simple and decently addicting with pretty beautiful graphics even all those years later. Level designs are.. Rather simplistic, which I do not really mind, though I personally prefer the 3D backgrounds of later games. There's some short story if you care for that, but it's mostly about the gameplay for most people, myself included. You just shoot balls into other balls to match 3 of same color. Despite the game being simple, there's a lot of thinking and fast action to be found in here, especially on higher difficulty levels. Power ups exist to help you out of tougher situations, but which one you will get is entirely random. You get the power ups for every 3rd match that you make without being inaccurate with your shots. If you can be fast in thinking and acting, as well as accurate with your shots, most of the levels shouldn't be a problem for you, which makes for a nice adrenaline rush every now and then. If you just want more relax, you can go with Casual difficulty. A few extra modes such as trying your best to survive as long as you can on any of the levels you have unlocked during Adventure mode are also present - Good fun for when you are done with Adventure mode and don't want to just keep replaying it all the time. This game has a little bit of something for everyone, no matter your age, gender or skill level in gaming, high recommend in 2024 and all the years going forward <3.

Mumbojumbo出品的Luxor，中文名一般叫做埃及祖玛。相较于宝开的祖玛而言，luxor系列似乎就没那么家喻户晓了。当初，随着祖玛问世后的大红大紫，众多开发商也纷纷仿照祖玛开发类似的游戏。不过在这之中，luxor系列算是比较成功的，它并没有完全仿照祖玛的模式，而是在原有基础上改编并加入了独有的元素，这也是为什么它能成为除了宝开的祖玛以外的又一大经典之作。经典自然无需多言，喜欢祖玛类游戏的朋友不妨试一试，我相信不会让大家失望的。[b]顺带一提，本作是开发商在原版的Luxor的基础上进行的重制。游戏中除了画质更加精美了以外，还增加了难度选择以及无尽模式，win10系统可以正常运行。捆绑包中的Luxor、Luxor 2和Luxor: Amun Rising在win10环境下似乎是无法运行的，因此win10用户可以购买这个HD版本，或者在对应游戏的社区寻找补丁。[/b]

This game is shiny, but 100% bad design in every other aspect - I loved Zuma, played for many hours (before Steam), this one is so annoying that I want to uninstall before completing it once.

This game is best enjoyed if you don't want to complete it, but play the first few levels (6-8). At that point you have 18-20 lives and a lot of suffering ahead. You can get through with 25-30% points earned (all gems wasted), but there is no sense of accomplishment, unlike in Zuma, where you build gaps, combos and shoot through for juicy points.

This one punishes clever plays, trying to build combos - or wasting balls - is considered inaccuracy, -60k points (30%).
High percentage of maps contradicts the game design of shooting balls upwards. Very often have to wait 10+ seconds to shoot.
There is a limit of 1 shot per second.
The game tries to help when the snake is close to the end, giving you just one color. Best effect when you can't shoot it for 30+ seconds due to map design.
It is so overtuned (maybe just 3rd-6th-9th-etc) that from around 65% completed you earn less and less points while all you get is Alert-Alert-Alert-Alert sounds.
